verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions emergency-stop, safety-interlock, or any documented safety pattern. The closest material is generic building blocks: predefined and custom commands, teleop buttons, and events that trigger commands. Under the partial-credit rule these are developer primitives a user could build on, not a documented safety capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can implement emergency-stop and safety-interlock patterns the platform documents and supports
